name: ml-lab
description: ML Lab — interactive AI-native machine learning laboratory

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @ml-lab/ml-core && npm run build -w @ml-lab/contracts && npm run build -w @ml-lab/i18n && npm run build -w @ml-lab/db && npm run build -w @ml-lab/sandbox && npm run build -w @ml-lab/agent-core
scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @ml-lab/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w web
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @ml-lab/api && npm run build -w web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
